description: Defines the HybridSlowStart class implementing hybrid slow start congestion control for TCP in the quic namespace, including methods for managing slow start phases, packet acknowledgments, and round tracking.

classes.name: HybridSlowStart
classes.description: A class implementing hybrid slow start congestion control for TCP in QUIC.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Handles the event of a packet being sent.

methods.name: ShouldExitSlowStart
methods.description: Determines if the slow start phase should be exited based on RTT measurements and congestion window.

methods.name: Restart
methods.description: Starts a new slow start phase.

methods.name: IsEndOfRound
methods.description: Checks if the current acknowledgment marks the end of a slow start round.

methods.name: StartReceiveRound
methods.description: Marks the start of a new receive round in slow start.

methods.name: started
methods.description: Returns whether slow start has begun.
